questions.question: What happens when NFL.com, a club chart and a news article disagree?
questions.known: Week 10 sources show status/depth lags and missing players.
questions.missing: A reconciled, timestamped authority policy.
questions.discovery: Preserve both observations, flag the conflict and suppress affected model inputs.

questions.question: What minimum evidence is required before a strategy is eligible?
questions.known: Thresholds must be declared before viewing results; this site proposes conservative design defaults.
questions.missing: Owner-approved sample, risk, calibration and shadow policy.
questions.discovery: Use the published proposed gates as research defaults; do not claim they are league rules.

questions.question: Are there internal contradictions inside the official data itself?
questions.known: Answered for the standings snapshot: all four integrity checks pass, but squad games-played are unequal (8 vs 9) because of byes and the in-progress slate.
questions.answer: Answered for the standings snapshot: all four integrity checks pass, but squad games-played are unequal (8 vs 9) because of byes and the in-progress slate.

questions.question: How does a value get into a table, and what stops an unverified value from being published?
questions.known: Answered as a mechanism. Every row carries a source id that must resolve to an official URL; the build fails if a row has no source. Unverified fields are null and render as '—' plus a flag.
questions.answer: Answered as a mechanism. Every row carries a source id that must resolve to an official URL; the build fails if a row has no source. Unverified fields are null and render as '—' plus a flag.

suggestions.title: Adopt an official-only evidence contract
suggestions.summary: Separate source authority, byte integrity and model validation. Community data may be exploratory only; canonical decision values require official confirmation.

suggestions.title: Buy an odds archive before building anything else
suggestions.summary: Purchase a historical odds archive that includes closing lines and, ideally, player-prop prices. Define 'closing line' as a single book and a single snapshot rule, in writing, before the first backtest.

suggestions.title: Ingest game-level results to make the ratings opponent-aware
suggestions.summary: Ingest weekly final scores from the official schedule/game pages, then fit an opponent-adjusted rating (least-squares or Elo-style) with home-field advantage and margin variance estimated from the data instead of assumed.

suggestions.title: Keep rewards recognition-only until approved
suggestions.summary: No money, credits or stake handling until budget, jurisdiction and legal review are verified.

suggestions.title: Secure permissioned odds and prop history
suggestions.summary: Obtain written terms for historical/live prices, limits, timestamps, props, retention and derived data.

suggestions.title: Add injury/depth ablations, not fixed penalties
suggestions.summary: Compare identical models with and without verified availability features using chronological holdouts.
suggestions.impact: Tests whether personnel information adds skill

suggestions.title: Automate build, citation and link gates
suggestions.summary: Fail CI on missing row sources, broken local links, duplicate IDs, conflict markers or unsupported verified badges.

suggestions.title: Build immutable official availability snapshots
suggestions.summary: Scheduled capture of NFL injury reports, club depth pages and inactive evidence with raw hashes, timestamps and conflict flags.

suggestions.title: Delay parlays until joint outcomes validate
suggestions.summary: Require matched leg outcomes, direct joint calibration, game-cluster uncertainty and book payout rules.

suggestions.title: Publish a conflict-aware review queue
suggestions.summary: Flag source lags, authority gaps, missing ranks and unsupported claims with official links and discovery actions.

suggestions.title: Start with a singles-only shadow baseline
suggestions.summary: Pre-register a simple team-strength model, freeze versions and record forecasts before kickoff.
suggestions.impact: Creates a clean benchmark before complexity

suggestions.title: Add durable snapshot storage and alerts
suggestions.summary: Store immutable captures outside the static site, monitor freshness and alert on source/schema changes.

suggestions.title: Expand to player-prop combinations last
suggestions.summary: Require verified participation, prop settlement, joint dependence and held-out calibration before any combo signal.
suggestions.impact: Addresses the hardest requested market safely

suggestions.title: Use proper-score leaderboard divisions
suggestions.summary: Separate singles, game parlays, same-game parlays and prop combos; rank eligible strategies by benchmark-relative skill with uncertainty.

suggestions.title: 2026 Kickoff & Declared Onside-Kick Regime Priors Filter
suggestions.summary: Avoids systematic bias in originated game totals and 4th-quarter comeback win-probability curves.
suggestions.depends: Requires 2026 play-by-play special-teams dataset verification (see Q-11).

suggestions.title: Add a compliance page for NL licensing and NFL prop restrictions before any betting use
suggestions.summary: Avoids using prohibited or unlicensed markets
suggestions.depends: Read Ksa rules and NFL primary policy

suggestions.title: Add a control baseline (random picks; favorites only) to every leaderboard run
suggestions.summary: Separates skill from luck

suggestions.title: Add a drift alarm to every scraper
suggestions.summary: Pin each parser to expected row counts and required fields; fail the build loudly when a field goes missing rather than publishing a blank.

suggestions.title: Add a per-team view: starters out, replacements named, net injury count
suggestions.summary: Quick team-level decision view

suggestions.title: Add a suggestion-review page with a comparison view
suggestions.summary: Ship a review page that shows every suggestion with its score, its blocking questions, what happens if it is skipped, and a side-by-side comparison of any two selected items.

suggestions.title: Add an official depth-chart register with date and source per row
suggestions.summary: Required to flag backups replacing starters on offense and defense
suggestions.depends: Identify an official depth-chart source (not found yet)

suggestions.title: Add search and filter to each table page (already started on Injuries)
suggestions.summary: Easier review of 254+ rows

suggestions.title: Archive weekly injury reports for past seasons (for Q06)
suggestions.summary: Only way to test whether designations change outcomes

suggestions.title: Automated Official-Domain Allowlist & Empty-Cell Integrity Pre-Commit Hook
suggestions.summary: Guarantees every future commit enforces semantic domain-to-topic matching and blocks inferred fill-ins for missing data.
suggestions.depends: Approve official domain allowlist policy (see Q-12).

suggestions.title: Automated link and verification check on every build (in place: scripts/check.mjs)
suggestions.summary: Stops broken links and rows without sources
suggestions.recommendation: Implemented (verification tooling only, required by the brief; no content change)

suggestions.title: Calibrate what "Questionable" means empirically instead of using old percentages
suggestions.summary: Official text gives no percentages

suggestions.title: Cap position-value weights at what can be defended
suggestions.summary: Publish the weights as an editable parameter table, show the index under a low/high weight set, and label every index value as assumption-driven.

suggestions.title: Choose one licensed odds source with opening and closing timestamps
suggestions.summary: Needed for any line analysis or CLV

suggestions.title: Do not price parlays or props until leg-level correlation is estimated
suggestions.summary: Block ST-04 to ST-10 at gate G0 until a leg-level dataset exists and pairwise rho is estimated per market cluster.

suggestions.title: Freeze a rule before it sees data (pre-registration)
suggestions.summary: Commit the rule text, the sample window and the gates to git before the evaluation window opens. The commit hash is the registration.

suggestions.title: Interactive Offense vs. Defense Matchup Deficiency Matrix (1st–4th String)
suggestions.summary: Surfaces immediate trench and coverage mismatches (e.g., WR1 facing promoted 2nd/3rd-string CB, or EDGE1 facing 2nd/3rd-string OT/LG) on one screen.
suggestions.depends: Requires multi-source player ID mapping across nfl.com/injuries/, club depth charts, and 53-man rosters (see Q-05).

suggestions.title: Joint-Simulation Correlation Explorer with Confidence Intervals
suggestions.summary: Prevents originating parlays or player prop combos on spurious historical correlations by requiring lower-bound confidence edge.
suggestions.depends: Requires aligned historical play-by-play and settled prop line archive (see Q-06, Q-07).

suggestions.title: Keep a written record of every rejected idea and every trial count
suggestions.summary: Log every strategy variant, including failures, with its timestamp, in a file that is append-only and committed.

suggestions.title: Keep the site analysis-only; no picks or recommendations
suggestions.summary: Reduces risk and keeps the decision with the owner

suggestions.title: Make closing-line value the headline metric, not ROI
suggestions.summary: Rank primarily on mean CLV in probability units with a confidence interval; treat realised ROI as a secondary diagnostic only.

suggestions.title: Point-in-Time Snapshot Ledger for Injuries, Depth Charts & Inactives
suggestions.summary: Prevents lookahead leakage when backtesting originated lines and preserves exact pre-kickoff replacement certainty.
suggestions.depends: Confirm NFL.com & club website terms of use or procure commercial feed license (see Q-02).

suggestions.title: Pre-Registered Strategy Registry & Deflated Multiple-Testing Audit Log
suggestions.summary: Forces every strategy trial—including failed parameter sweeps—into the denominator of False Discovery Rate (FDR) and Deflated Sharpe checks.
suggestions.depends: Requires agreement on minimum effective sample size and alpha threshold before first backtest run (see Q-08).

suggestions.title: Pre-register each strategy (definition frozen before results are seen)
suggestions.summary: Prevents result-chasing

suggestions.title: Publish a weekly 'what changed' diff instead of a static snapshot
suggestions.summary: Store each weekly snapshot and render a diff column (rank change, rating change, availability change).

suggestions.title: Publish every model total twice until one wins
suggestions.summary: Keep both estimators visible with the gap column, and only collapse to one after a walk-forward comparison.

suggestions.title: Publish the unverified items as a first-class page, not a footnote
suggestions.summary: A dedicated Flagged for Review page listing every unverified value, every irregularity, the source links, and what would clear it.

suggestions.title: Reject: deriving depth order from jersey number, experience or salary
suggestions.summary: Proposed shortcut for SG-05: infer starters from roster attributes on the official roster page.

suggestions.title: Reject: ranking strategies by season-long ROI
suggestions.summary: Proposed alternative to SG-03: rank purely on realised return over the season.

suggestions.title: Resolve the depth-order source before building the backup-deficiency feature
suggestions.summary: Evaluate two routes in order: (a) per-club official depth chart pages, verified club by club; (b) derive depth from snap counts if an official snap-count source exists. Do not build the feature until one route is verified for all 32 clubs.

suggestions.title: Score injury-designation reliability before using it as a feature
suggestions.summary: Join several seasons of designations to the official inactive lists and measure the play rate per designation with confidence intervals. Only then decide whether the label becomes a model feature.

suggestions.title: Snapshot the nfl.com injury report every Wed, Thu and Fri and keep a dated history
suggestions.summary: Lets us see Questionable→Out changes and practice trends (DNP→LP→FP)
suggestions.depends: Scheduled job (manual or CI) and storage in repo

suggestions.title: Split data into train, validation and final holdout seasons
suggestions.summary: Protects out-of-sample testing

suggestions.title: Split the site into a public analysis layer and a private data layer
suggestions.summary: Keep the public site to derived analysis (indices, ratios, model output, links to the official page) and hold raw row-level data in a private store until the terms are read.

suggestions.title: Stadium Roof/Surface & NWS Hourly Wind/Precipitation Overlay
suggestions.summary: Prevents totals and passing-prop mispricing by coupling NWS forecast grids with official 90-minute stadium roof designations.
suggestions.depends: Requires stadium coordinate registry and international weather source selection (see Q-10).

suggestions.title: Treat the injury report as a timestamped series, not a weekly snapshot
suggestions.summary: Capture the report daily from Wednesday to kickoff with the fetch timestamp, then measure how designations evolve.

suggestions.title: Two-Stage Skill Leaderboard (Proper-Score Qualification -> Prospective CLV/ROI Escrow)
suggestions.summary: Aligns incentives strictly with calibrated probabilistic skill (Brier Skill Score + Closing Line Value) over multi-week prospective samples.
suggestions.depends: Requires legal/compliance sign-off on competition reward structure in applicable jurisdictions (see Q-01, Q-09).

suggestions.title: Unified Root Navigation Bridging Parallel Session Workspaces
suggestions.summary: Gives human reviewers a single canonical entry bar comparing all session audits without losing any session's verified evidence.
suggestions.depends: Requires cross-session lock release or owner approval per COORDINATION.md.

suggestions.title: Use snap counts as the starter proxy when the depth chart is unavailable
suggestions.summary: Gives a measurable starter/backup split

suggestions.title: Vig-Free Market Consensus vs. Originated Fair-Line Decomposition View
suggestions.summary: Separates true pricing divergence (origination alpha) from operator vig/margin before any bet structure is considered.
suggestions.depends: Requires licensed historical & live sportsbook quote archive and jurisdiction clearance (see Q-01, Q-03).

strategies.name: Pace and possession efficiency
strategies.thesis: Neutral pace and points-per-possession improve total forecasts over raw points per game.
strategies.note: Pre-registered total model; held-out calibration and market comparison.

strategies.name: Availability-adjusted line versus market
strategies.thesis: The full pipeline: model line, then adjust for verified availability, then compare with the market. This is the strategy the whole project exists to build.
strategies.status: BLOCKED at G0. Two of its five inputs do not exist yet (market, depth order).
strategies.note: Model margin -> availability adjustment (A-04 weights) -> compare with market -> bet the residual above threshold.

strategies.name: Backup QB start – total under
strategies.thesis: Backup QB starts lower scoring totals
strategies.note: Uses headline-verified events only

strategies.name: Control: favorites only
strategies.thesis: Market-implied baseline

strategies.name: Control: random side each game
strategies.thesis: No edge expected; used to measure luck

strategies.name: Cross-game parlay value
strategies.thesis: Only combinations with verified joint pricing and demonstrated dependence treatment may have value.
strategies.note: Direct joint probability versus independence baseline; held-out joint Brier score.

strategies.name: Defensive depth deficiency (secondary/line)
strategies.thesis: Multiple DNP defensive starters raise opponent scoring
strategies.note: See Q02

strategies.name: Divisional compression
strategies.thesis: Familiarity compresses margins. The measured correlation between division form and overall form is only +0.33 (p=0.066, n=32), i.e. division results carry real but modest extra information.
strategies.note: In divisional games, shade the underdog and the under. Reject if the market total already sits below the model total by the declared threshold.

strategies.name: Injury-news timing reaction
strategies.thesis: Forecasts updated only after verified status changes may beat stale baselines if execution is feasible.
strategies.note: Event-time study with no future information; execution-cost stress test.

strategies.name: Injury-status change fade
strategies.thesis: A starter moving Questionable→Out at Friday designation moves the line less than the true effect
strategies.note: Hypothesis only

strategies.name: Line movement after injury news (CLV)
strategies.thesis: Line moves faster than correct adjustment after headline news

strategies.name: Net injury differential – spread
strategies.thesis: Net weighted injury count predicts margin error
strategies.note: Weights must be pre-registered (SG-07)

strategies.name: Offensive line replacement – rushing under
strategies.thesis: Backup OL reduces rushing yards for the team

strategies.name: Offensive-line replacement stress
strategies.thesis: Multiple verified OL replacements degrade protection/run efficiency beyond what the market prices.
strategies.note: Role-weighted exposure model versus unweighted injury count; chronological holdout.

strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted team strength
strategies.thesis: Rolling offense/defense efficiency with opponent and context adjustments improves spread/total forecasts versus a simple baseline.
strategies.note: Walk-forward by game; compare Brier/log loss and calibration against frozen baseline and market.

strategies.name: Practice-trend signal (DNP→LP→FP)
strategies.thesis: Improving practice trend predicts availability better than the label

strategies.name: Pythagorean luck regression
strategies.thesis: Clubs whose win total runs ahead of their scoring margin should regress. This build measures that gap directly: 76.7% of win-pct variance is explained by scoring margin, leaving 23.3% as the pool where luck lives.
strategies.status: BLOCKED at G0. The signal is computed from official data; the test is impossible without prices.
strategies.note: Fade clubs with luck_wins >= +1.5, back clubs with luck_wins <= -1.5, only while the market has not already priced the regression.

strategies.name: Quarterback availability shock
strategies.thesis: Confirmed QB absence/replacement changes team scoring enough to create incremental forecast value.
strategies.note: Ablate availability feature; cluster uncertainty by game; require held-out improvement.

strategies.name: Quarterback-out offence fade
strategies.thesis: A verified starting-QB absence is the largest single availability shock in the sport. The injury report makes the absence official; the market has to reprice it.
strategies.status: BLOCKED at G0, and additionally dependent on Q-09 for the 'starting QB' determination.
strategies.note: If the starting QB is Out or Doubtful on the official report, apply the declared QB weight to the team's model rating and require a residual edge.

strategies.name: Rating-mismatch spread
strategies.thesis: Bet when the model's margin disagrees with the market by more than a declared threshold, and the disagreement is not explained by information the market has and the model does not (injuries, weather, rest).
strategies.status: BLOCKED at G0 — no odds archive (F-04). The model exists; the market does not.
strategies.note: If |model_margin - market_margin| >= 2.0 points after an injury adjustment, take the side the model prefers at the best available price.

strategies.name: Receiver opportunity prop
strategies.thesis: Verified target-share/air-yard changes under personnel shifts may improve reception/yardage forecasts.
strategies.note: Player-grouped chronological validation; compare with book-implied probability.

strategies.name: Receiver target-share prop
strategies.thesis: Target share is stickier than yards per target. Price the volume, let the efficiency vary.
strategies.note: Project targets from verified share, convert with the player's own distribution; require the offered line to sit at least one standard deviation from the projection.

strategies.name: Rest and schedule asymmetry
strategies.thesis: Unequal rest (Thursday games, bye weeks, international travel) is a priced-in discount that is sometimes mispriced. This season has nine international games and a Week 11 schedule change, so the population of unusual spots is unusually large.
strategies.status: BLOCKED at G0. Schedule facts are verifiable; the effect size is not estimable here.
strategies.note: Flag games with rest differential >= 3 days or a travel-time zone change >= 5 hours; require a model edge beyond the declared threshold.

strategies.name: Running-back workload prop
strategies.thesis: Opportunity drives production. A back whose snap share and carry share are verified rising is mispriced if the market lags usage.
strategies.status: BLOCKED at G0, G10 — no usage data (Q-03) and no confirmation route for participation.
strategies.note: Project attempts from recent share, convert to yards with a per-carry distribution, and price the over. Blocked unless the player is confirmed active.

strategies.name: Rushing workload prop combo
strategies.thesis: Confirmed replacement workload and game script may jointly affect rushing attempts/yards.
strategies.note: Joint outcome model with game-cluster bootstrap and independence comparison.

strategies.name: Same-game parlay: QB passing yards over + WR1 receptions over
strategies.thesis: Legs are positively correlated; price may not reflect it
strategies.note: Correlation must be measured

strategies.name: Same-game script combination
strategies.thesis: Game-script-linked legs require conditional joint modeling rather than multiplying marginals.
strategies.note: Estimate dependence on training games; validate joint calibration and payout EV out of sample.

strategies.name: Secondary attrition versus the pass
strategies.thesis: Cornerback and safety attrition is the defensive analogue of a QB absence, and it is visible on the official report by position.
strategies.status: BLOCKED at G0. The availability half is verified; the valuation half is an explicit assumption (A-04).
strategies.note: Count verified CB/S unavailability, weight by the declared defensive-back weights, and compare the repriced total with the market.

strategies.name: Secondary replacement exposure
strategies.thesis: Verified defensive-back replacements affect passing efficiency and scoring conditional on coverage role.
strategies.note: Compare defense-exposure feature ablation with game-cluster intervals.

strategies.name: Team total under + game total under (parlay)
strategies.thesis: Legs correlated through pace/game script

strategies.name: Three-leg same-game script parlay
strategies.thesis: QB passing yards + WR receiving yards + team total over share a common driver. The equicorrelated factor model shows the joint probability is materially higher than the product of the legs.
strategies.status: BLOCKED at G0, G9, G10. Highest variance of anything here; the most gate exposure; the most attractive to overconfident operators. That combination is why G9/G10 are hard gates.
strategies.note: Price with the three-leg copula; require the offered price to exceed the copula fair price by the declared margin; reject if rho cannot be estimated.

strategies.name: Two-leg cross-game parlay
strategies.thesis: Legs in different games are close to independent, so the product rule is roughly valid. The book's parlay price is therefore the fair product minus a hold — a pure price-taking bet with no informational edge.
strategies.status: BLOCKED at G0. Included on the board deliberately as the control case: if this strategy ever shows profit, suspect the grading, not the skill.
strategies.note: Never bet without a leg-level edge; the parlay multiplier cannot create one.

strategies.name: Two-leg same-game parlay (team total + spread)
strategies.thesis: Two legs on the same team are strongly positively correlated, so an independent-leg price overpays the bettor. The engine quantifies the size of that mispricing for any rho.
strategies.status: BLOCKED at G0 and G9 — no SGP prices and no leg-level dataset to estimate rho (F-09).
strategies.note: Price the joint with a Gaussian copula and estimated rho; bet only if the offered SGP price exceeds the copula fair price by the declared margin.

strategies.name: Uncorrelated 2-leg parlay of two single games (control)
strategies.thesis: Parlay EV without correlation adjustment (control)

gates.name: As-of integrity
gates.criterion: Feature availability and quote timestamps precede forecast time; forecast precedes kickoff; training games end before holdout games.
gates.failure: Future information, overlapping game clusters or retrospective edits.

gates.name: Bootstrap lower bound
gates.criterion: 10,000-resample bootstrap 95% CI lower bound on mean edge > 0.
gates.failure: Not admitted.

gates.name: Capacity
gates.criterion: Intended stake <= 5% of the typical available limit in that market; edge survives at the achievable price, not just the best price.
gates.failure: Downgraded to 'research only'; may not receive reward allocation.

gates.name: Closing-line value positive
gates.criterion: Positive CLV vs. the chosen closing benchmark (Q14)
gates.failure: Not admitted, even if realised ROI is positive.

gates.name: Completeness
gates.criterion: Required fields, identifiers, coverage and duplicate checks pass; unknown cells remain blank and flagged.
gates.failure: Silent imputation, duplicate events or missing settlement.

gates.name: Compliance
gates.criterion: Market is lawful for the user and not in a prohibited prop category as reported (Q12, Q13)
gates.failure: Proposed – see Q13 (unverified)

gates.name: Correlation check (parlays)
gates.criterion: Leg correlation measured from data; parlay EV adjusted for it
gates.failure: Proposed

gates.name: Correlation integrity
gates.criterion: Joint probability is priced from estimated pairwise rho per market cluster, not from independence. rho must be estimated on >= 2 seasons and reported per cluster.
gates.failure: Parlay strategies are BLOCKED (not merely unscored).

gates.name: Data provenance
gates.criterion: Each input has an official or licensed source URL and timestamp
gates.failure: Proposed

gates.name: Data sufficiency
gates.criterion: A complete, timestamped record of the price available at decision time and the closing price, for every bet. No look-ahead: no field may be populated from a source published after the decision timestamp.
gates.needs: Odds archive with snapshot times; games logs; leg-level outcomes for props
gates.failure: Strategy cannot be scored at all. State: BLOCKED, reason recorded.

gates.name: Deflated Sharpe
gates.criterion: Deflated Sharpe ratio (Bailey & Lopez de Prado) > 0.95 given the trial count.
gates.failure: Not admitted.

gates.name: Dependence / combos
gates.criterion: Matched joint outcomes validate direct joint probability and dependence against an independence baseline.
gates.failure: Sparse pairs, marginal-only pricing or test-set correlation fitting.

gates.name: Governance
gates.criterion: Versioned rule text, immutable bet log, pre-registration commit hash, and a recorded trial count. No rule may change inside an evaluation window.
gates.needs: Git commit before first graded bet
gates.failure: Not admitted.

gates.name: Leakage check
gates.criterion: Signal uses only information available before the line lock
gates.failure: Proposed

gates.name: Locked holdout
gates.criterion: >= 30% of the available seasons are never used for design, and are evaluated exactly once.
gates.needs: Season-level split recorded before model work
gates.failure: Not admitted; the holdout cannot be reused for that strategy.

gates.name: Market executability
gates.criterion: Permissioned timestamped price, limits/latency, vig, push/void and settlement rules are documented.
gates.failure: No actionable price or unverifiable grading.

gates.name: Minimum sample
gates.criterion: At least N bets per strategy (N to be set by owner; e.g., 300 singles)
gates.failure: Proposed – decision needed (Q17)

gates.name: Official provenance
gates.criterion: Every decision input has an official source URL, retrieval time, raw hash and field-level confirmation; community data is excluded from official-only claims.
gates.failure: Missing authority, hash mismatch or inferred value.

gates.name: Out-of-sample
gates.criterion: Rules fixed on training seasons; tested on a holdout not used for design
gates.failure: Proposed

gates.name: Out-of-sample skill
gates.criterion: Walk-forward proper-score improvement over a frozen baseline survives game-cluster uncertainty and multiplicity adjustment.
gates.failure: Uncertainty includes no improvement, or evidence disappears in untouched holdout.

gates.name: Participation gating (props)
gates.criterion: A prop is only eligible if the player's availability is resolved (official designation, then inactive list), and the usage assumption is validated against the player's own recent workload.
gates.needs: Official designations + inactive list + snap/usage data
gates.failure: Prop strategies BLOCKED.

gates.name: Personnel robustness
gates.criterion: Availability features use dated official/club evidence with authority labels; conflicts or stale sources trigger abstention.
gates.failure: Depth rank inferred from injury listing or fixed unsupported penalty.

gates.name: Pre-registered sample size
gates.criterion: n >= required_n for the smallest edge the strategy claims to detect, with n fixed BEFORE evaluation.
gates.failure: Result is reported as 'insufficient evidence', never as 'promising'.

gates.name: Pre-registration
gates.criterion: Model version, feature set, thresholds, benchmark and complete trial family are hashed before evaluation.
gates.failure: Post-hoc rule changes or hidden failed trials.

gates.name: Prospective shadow
gates.criterion: Frozen forecasts are logged before outcomes and monitored for drift, calibration and freshness.
gates.failure: No independent prospective record or changed rules after seeing results.

gates.name: Reward eligibility
gates.criterion: Only strategies passing G01-G09 enter a division leaderboard; rewards require approved funding and legal policy.
gates.failure: Raw win-rate ranking, lucky streak reward or unresolved dispute.

gates.name: Robustness
gates.criterion: Stable across season halves and not driven by one week
gates.failure: Proposed

gates.name: Segment stability
gates.criterion: The sign of the edge agrees in >= 3 of 4 segments: home/away, favourite/underdog, first/second half of season, conference.
gates.failure: Not admitted; log which segment reversed.

gates.name: Significance with multiple tests
gates.criterion: Result survives correction for all strategies tested
gates.failure: Proposed

gates.name: Statistical significance with multiplicity
gates.criterion: t-statistic on mean CLV >= the Bonferroni threshold for the number of trials actually logged (thresholds printed below, computed from the trial count — never quoted from prose).
gates.failure: Not admitted. The trial count must be honest or the gate is void.

gates.name: Walk-forward only
gates.criterion: Every parameter used at time t is estimated only from data strictly before t. No retrospective parameter selection.
gates.failure: Not admitted.

flags.title: The official injury page changed 25 rows in sixteen hours
flags.detail: The 06:32Z capture holds 254 rows across 24 clubs with four 'No Injuries Reported' sections. Re-read at 22:25Z the same day the page held 279 rows: Seattle and Cincinnati had published 19 rows that did not exist in the morning, six more rows were added to four clubs, and four Colts practice statuses moved in both directions. Nothing was removed.
flags.impact: A single capture cannot support any availability feature. Questionable to Out transitions and the Thursday to Friday practice progression are only recoverable from a dated series.
flags.action: Store every capture with its timestamp and hash and keep the history. Treat any figure computed from one capture as provisional.

flags.title: Patriots depth rows are labelled 'club depth chart' but the page disclaims itself
flags.detail: The committed capture labels all 60 Patriots depth rows with authority 'club depth chart'. The page itself states: 'The 2026 depth chart is unofficial and is published by the writers of Patriots.com. The depth chart reflects the opinions of the Patriots.com writers and don't necessarily reflect those of the organization.'
flags.impact: Any chain built on Patriots rows inherits an opinion, not a club statement. Ben Brown, Carlton Davis III and TreVeyon Henderson are all ruled Out and all three chains come from this page.
flags.action: Re-label those rows as club-published unofficial and exclude them from official-only gates until the source says otherwise.

flags.title: 43 injured players do not appear at their position on their own club chart
flags.detail: Players the league report lists, who hold no published string at the matching position on the club depth chart. Lucas Patrick (Commanders C, ruled Out) and Malik Harrison (Giants LB, Questionable) are two of them; both were checked against the live club page this session.
flags.impact: For these players no published next-man-up exists. A replacement cannot be named from official data and must stay blank.
flags.action: Treat as unresolved. Do not substitute a roster order or a third-party depth chart.

flags.title: Third and fourth strings are not published for 500 of 676 position groups
flags.detail: Across the 30 captured club charts, most positions publish one or two strings. Only a minority publish a third, and a handful publish a fourth.
flags.impact: The requirement to track second, third and fourth string replacements cannot be met from official club charts at their current depth. Where a third string is needed and not published, the cell is blank.
flags.action: Source a participation or snap-count feed, or accept that depth beyond the published second string is unknown.

flags.title: Two Week 10 clubs have no depth capture at all
flags.detail: No club depth rows were captured for: Packers, Texans. Every injury row for those clubs resolves to 'no depth capture'.
flags.impact: Availability for those clubs cannot be assessed end to end.
flags.action: Extend the capture to all 32 clubs and fail the build when Week 10 coverage is incomplete.

flags.title: Published strings are not always one player
flags.detail: The Seahawks chart packs Cooper Kupp and Rashid Shaheed into a single first-string wide-receiver cell; the Commanders and Patriots publish two and three separate rows at the same position, so more than one player carries the same published rank.
flags.impact: 'First string' and 'second string' are ambiguous at those positions. The chain table reports every player sharing a string instead of choosing one.
flags.action: Keep the ambiguity visible; do not resolve it by guess.

flags.title: Status is a category, not a probability
flags.detail: The official policy defines Did Not Participate, Limited (less than 100 percent of normal repetitions) and Full (100 percent). Game status: Questionable means uncertain, Doubtful means unlikely, Out means will not play. The policy states a player certain to play is not listed in the Game Status Report at all.
flags.impact: A Questionable designation carries no calibrated playing probability. Any model that converts these labels into likelihoods is inventing numbers.
flags.action: Use status as an ordinal feature only, and calibrate probabilities against graded outcomes once a licensed result history exists.

flags.title: Inherited strategy text carries figures computed on community data
flags.detail: Some strategy rows merged from other workspaces quote correlations, p-values and matchup constants in their thesis or risk text. Those numbers were computed on nflverse community assets, not on official NFL data, but the row they sit in carries an official source link, which makes them look better sourced than they are.
flags.impact: A reader can mistake a community-data figure for an official-source finding.
flags.action: Each row now carries a Basis marker: 'carries computed figures' or 'hypothesis only'. Treat any marked row as exploratory until it is recomputed on a licensed source.

flags.title: One question row cites a secondary news source as its evidence
flags.detail: A question about which prop bets the NFL restricts cites a Yahoo Sports article. The league's own memo has not been located on an official host, so the underlying claim is unverified even though the row is not blank.
flags.impact: The row looks evidenced when it is not. This repeats a flag already raised by the dashboard session (R-12).
flags.action: Find the primary NFL policy document or mark the answer unverified.

flags.title: No licensed odds, prop or settlement archive is held
flags.detail: No odds history, player-prop line history or settlement record exists in this repository. Every strategy on the leaderboard is therefore blocked at the data gate, and no closing line value, return or rank can be computed.
flags.impact: Nothing can be scored. Every strategy stays at 'not run' by construction, not by choice.
flags.action: Obtain written terms for historical and live prices before any leaderboard can produce a result.
